meta.description: Weekly continuous-eval lane. A Schedule Trigger calls the `lanes` service (GET lanes:8081/eval-metrics?days=7, header x-lanes-token from $env.LANES_TOKEN), which runs scripts/eval_metrics.py over the audit ledger and returns analyze() as JSON. n8n cannot run python itself (hardened image — see docs/decisions/0006), so the lane runs in `lanes` while the SCHEDULE, EXECUTION LOG and Notify seam stay in n8n. A Code node formats agentic-leverage + quality metrics and any drift WARNs into { severity, title, message, source }; severity is 'warn' if any drift flag OR the ledger hash chain fails to verify OR the lane call fails. This measures metadata the router already logs; it is NOT a semantic eval — see docs/design/EVAL.md. Deploy with scripts/n8n_bootstrap.py — no UI clicks.
